title: Travelease
description: Travelease is a travel and activity booking platform that makes it easy for users to discover, plan and book the best experiences in a variety of destinations.

caseSolved.challenge: Travelers needed a faster way to compare destinations, activities, and booking options without losing context on smaller screens.
caseSolved.approach: I translated the booking requirements into a clear information architecture, designed the destination-to-activity discovery flow, built the responsive React interface, connected and tested the supporting API flows, and prepared the application for deployment. The implementation was refined through responsive QA and interaction-focused iteration.
caseSolved.techStack: React, Tailwind CSS, Material UI, Vite, Figma, Postman, Git, GitHub, Vercel, and VS Code were used to build, test, document, and deliver the platform.
caseSolved.innovation: The experience uses a strong destination hierarchy, fast filtering, reusable activity presentation, and responsive booking states so users can move from exploration to decision-making with less friction.
caseSolved.impact: Users can discover and compare travel activities more confidently, then continue toward booking through a consistent experience across desktop and mobile.

caseSolved.innovation: The platform turns a complex college search into a guided journey with structured comparison, clearer decision points, and progressive academic planning instead of presenting students with a static information dump.
caseSolved.impact: Students get a more focused path from discovering suitable universities to understanding their options and planning the next stage of their education.
